parent: HG-08 registered CPU experiment; built on stacked HG07/HG08 research branch
scope: synthetic parity mechanism with explicit algebraic prior, not an emergent neuron or trained SAE
generator: HG07 core_140 rank1 six-sparse uniform binary state, per-world SHA256 keyed independent splits
independent_unit: world seed, 64 new worlds; no HG03 private seeds, no reused HG07/HG08 seeds
prior_protocol: Use only training input and goal labels to Gaussian-eliminate a GF(2) system, require unique 140-rank solution and exactly six support bits. Compile recovered sparse parity to fixed product circuit. Sham uses six different support coordinates sampled from complement without test data. No auxiliary true-fragment labels.
computational_matching: All arms use identical training examples. Neural arms get 350 equal-step AdamW updates, with flat/recurrent matching HG07 parameter shape and random batches. Record GF2 fit+compile CPU cost and neural training time per world. The structural algorithm is privileged by its parity-family prior, so equal data/steps is not equal inductive information.
calibration: Laplace q=(cal_correct+1)/258 > 3/5 release; freeze before test; all arms score 256 test labels once.
intervention: After all arms are fixed, select one true-support coordinate and one irrelevant coordinate by SHA256 seed only, before test scores. For each of 256 test inputs, flip chosen bit. Measure predicted flip vs truth flip on target and prediction invariance on irrelevant bit; sham circuit is a six-coordinate disjoint support.

primary_hypotheses.outcome: world macro accuracy difference sparse_gf2_compiled minus loop_task
primary_hypotheses.test: FSI-01 cluster sign-flip; conservative positive effect floor

primary_hypotheses.outcome: World-macro binary causal-selectivity success (prediction flips on the chosen true-support bit and remains invariant under the chosen irrelevant bit), sparse compiled minus disjoint six-support sham; all 256 paired test states per world
primary_hypotheses.test: FSI-01 world-level sign flip; conservative effect floor

evidence_boundary: Even a perfect sparse circuit proves only that a supplied GF2 parity prior supports train-only exact support recovery and the causal prediction circuit. Does not establish discovery of a neuron-level or natural language mechanism.
sealed_policy: No score-based choice of architecture, seeds, intervention directions, dosage or checkpoint. Test labels touched only after training+calibration and support selection.
amendment: Pre-data clarification: causal selectivity is a binary per-state paired outcome in [0,1] suitable for FSI-01; replaces difference of two rates in [-2,2]. No results were generated before this amendment.
smoke_amendment: Two initial synthetic world seeds were exposed in a 2-world implementation smoke test before the full preregistered run. They were replaced with 2026113065, 2026113066 before running/scoring any confirmation worlds. Retain this pre-data amendment for provenance.
